mapper.sql: select t.id, t.task_name, t.source_name, t.trigger_type, t.status, t.started_time, t.completed_time, coalesce(c.inserted_count, 0) + coalesce(c.updated_count, 0) as fetched_count, coalesce(c.inserted_count, 0) as inserted_count, coalesce(c.updated_count, 0) as updated_count, coalesce(c.duplicate_count, 0) as duplicate_count, t.filtered_count, t.failed_count, coalesce(m.mysql_inserted_count, 0) as mysql_inserted_count, coalesce(m.mysql_updated_count, 0) as mysql_updated_count, coalesce(m.mysql_existing_count, 0) as mysql_existing_count, t.statistics_version, t.crawl_run_id, t.error_message, t.publish_time_start, t.publish_time_end, t.force_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark from business_news_collect t left join ( select r.crawl_task_id, sum(case when upper(ifnull(r.operation,'')) = 'INSERTED' then 1 else 0 end) as inserted_count, sum(case when upper(ifnull(r.operation,'')) = 'UPDATED' then 1 else 0 end) as updated_count, sum(case when upper(ifnull(r.operation,'')) like 'DUPLICATE%' and not exists ( select 1 from business_knowledge k where k.source_type = 'NEWS' and k.source_code = concat('NEWS-ARTICLE-', r.article_id) and k.status = '2' and k.current_version_id is not null ) then 1 else 0 end) as duplicate_count from business_news_collect_article r group by r.crawl_task_id ) c on c.crawl_task_id = t.id left join ( select crawl_task_id, sum(case when mysql_operation = 'MYSQL_INSERTED' then 1 else 0 end) as mysql_inserted_count, sum(case when mysql_operation = 'MYSQL_UPDATED' then 1 else 0 end) as mysql_updated_count, sum(case when mysql_operation = 'MYSQL_EXISTING' then 1 else 0 end) as mysql_existing_count from business_news_collect_article group by crawl_task_id ) m on m.crawl_task_id = t.id
mapper.select: select distinct source_name from business_news_collect where source_name is not null and source_name != '' order by source_name
